messages:
elenab: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a short docs update to clarify SOC2 audit-log semantics for tenant-scoped data, retention defaults, and a tiny SDK migration note. Need an example for tenant separation and one snippet for the JS SDK. PTAL?

shaun: Yep, can you paste the current snippet here so I can suggest the minimal change?

elenab: Pasting current example below (this is what lives in the audit-log section today):
```json
{
  "event": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "T123",
  "payload": { "prompt": "..." },
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z"
}
```
We currently say: "Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days by default." Need to: 1) show how tenant-scoped retention works, 2) add a migration snippet for SDK rename, 3) avoid promising more than we support.

docs-linter-bot: lint: SOC2 guide - avoid absolute phrasing like "we store"; prefer "by default" or "customers may configure".

legal_jess: +1 on cautious language. Suggest wording: "Audit logs are retained by default for 90 days; customers can request extended retention as part of an enterprise contract. Redwood does not expose tenant log data to other tenants." Also add an encryption callout: "Logs encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys available for Private deployments."

shaun: For the SDK snippet migration, change the JS client call example from `client.audit.log({...})` to `client.audit.emit({...})`. Proposed inline migration note:
```js
// Old
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'T123', payload });
// New
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'T123', data: payload });
```
Add: "The parameter names changed: event -> name, payload -> data."

elenab: Perfect. I'll add both the tenant example and the migration note. Question for @kevin: do we want to include the API path (e.g., `/v1/audit`) in docs or keep it abstracted behind SDK?

kevin: Keep the docs SDK-first. Add a short appendix showing the curl form for operators only, but don't make it prominent. Also add KMS note: "For Private deployments, customers can configure KMS for log encryption."

elenab: Great — I'll: 1) update language to "retained by default for 90 days; configurable for enterprise", 2) add tenant-scoped JSON example with explicit tenant_id and redaction note, 3) include the JS migration snippet, and 4) append a small curl example in an appendix. Will open a PR and ping reviewers.

shaun: nit: include a one-line example showing redaction pattern: `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` so we offer a clear opt-in for PII redaction.

elenab: Added that too. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2467 (WIP). PTAL when you have a minute and leave :eyes: comments.

kevin: I'll review tomorrow morning and check the KMS wording.

legal_jess: If you want faster turnaround on legal phrasing, tag me in the PR and add `legal:review` label.

elenab: Will do. Thanks everyone — will update here when PR merges. :shipit:
